comment: His lectures were very clear and fun. The homework was not too difficult if you have read the chapter in the book. Everything was great in class until his first test came along. Horrible tests. He joked about his test averages ususally being in the 60's. Which mine were! It is possible to make a B!
I'm taking Physics just out of interest but he's making me loving it! He's very fun in class. I'm definitely taking him again and I'd recommend him to anyone!

Class is hard if you do not have prior physics experience. Likes the ladies. His tests are four questions for a total of four tests (including the final) the entire semester. The homework is graded weirdly (lose entire points for messing up on one part of a question) but overall the class is entertaining and fun. Can be a bit long on fridays
